The '''Bextar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bextar]] and three other [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]].<ref name="JOUR3" />
